presets.tagline: Polished anime look in 14 steps
presets.description:
Fast anime pictures with one strong, consistent style: clean linework, rich colour and solid faces. Built to finish in 12-15 steps, about 12 seconds for a 1 MP picture on a 12 GB card.

Prompt with Danbooru tags, plain sentences, or both. For a known character, look up its exact tag on animadex.net first. Keep CFG around 3-4; higher looks forced.

The author forbids re-uploading the model to PixAI.

presets.name: Riaku Lab v1.0
presets.tagline: Painterly light and atmosphere; give it long prompts
presets.description:
An experimental Anima aimed at painterly atmosphere and complex lighting. In our test it was the most different of the newer Anima cards: warm backlight, glowing haze and a painterly finish.

Give it long prompts. The author warns it can be unstable with short ones, so describe the scene, the light and the mood.

The author gives no settings, so the card uses the Anima base card's. About 18 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

presets.name: Unholy Desire Mix Dark Serenity v3.0
presets.tagline: Crisp, polished Anima anime; follows long prompts closely
presets.description:
Crisp, polished anime with clean faces and careful detail on armour, hair and clothing. In our side-by-side test it kept every attribute of a busy two-character prompt in place. The card uses the author's quality tags and negative. About 15 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

If you want more speed, the CFG slider goes down to 1, and with 16 steps that renders in about 5 seconds. That is the author's own minimum, but in our test it dropped details (a sword became a spear, capes went missing) and mixed up who wears what.

Mature-capable.

Civitai asks for a sign-in to download (API key). Licence (Civitai): image use, on-site generation and selling images allowed; derivatives allowed.

presets.name: CocoaMix Anima v4.0
presets.tagline: Clean, soft, bright anime with the cocoaface look
presets.description:
Clean, soft, bright anime. About 22 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card; the author gives no settings, so the card uses the Anima base card's.

A few things to check. It added a small made-up print to a plain hoodie on all four test seeds, so look at clothing. By default it draws eyes without pupils: add 'dark circle pupils' to get them. Animal girls lose their human ears by default too: add 'human ears' if you want them. For realistic pictures, the author says to remove 'real' from the negative.

This is a different model from Krea2 CocoaMix.

Pictures made with it are non-commercial; ask the author about commercial use. Civitai also lists it as RentCivit only, no derivatives, with a fee for reprinting the model.
